name: Carson City: Big Box

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after round 4, once everyone has spent money above their character's cash limit

categories.label: Victory points gained during the game
categories.hint: Marker position on the VP track; includes VP bought for money and VP for money spent over the cash limit.

categories.label: Buildings, houses and mountains
categories.hint: 2 VP each; bought-but-unbuilt buildings and empty plots score nothing.

categories.label: Remaining money
categories.hint: $6 per VP at game end (rounding assumed down).

categories.label: Station (if in play)
categories.hint: 1 VP per 2 house symbols in the city (station counts as 2 houses); enter house symbols.

categories.label: Horses expansion (optional)
categories.hint: 1 VP per horse, plus 1 more per horse for each rodeo won.

tiebreakers.description: The tied player who passed first in the final round wins.

notes: VP are gained during play (building, plot, pistol, duel and purchase actions) and tracked on the VP track; spending $10 over the cash limit gives 1 VP each round end. Station rule only applies if the Station building is used; set stationVp to 0 otherwise. Horses VP applies only with the Horses expansion; unclear if Big Box contents include it, so keep optional. Rounding of leftover money not stated explicitly in the rulebook; floor assumed. Gold & Guns / other expansions and character power variants not modelled.
